titleEn: Maximum Number of Ways to Partition an Array
title: 分割数组的最多方案数
summary: 可把至多一个元素改为 k，求左右和相等的分割位置最大数量。
insight: 对每个分割 k 记录差 diff=2*prefix-total。改变下标 j、增量 delta 后，j 左侧的分割需要 diff=delta，j 右侧的分割需要 diff=-delta。扫描改变位置并用左右频次表维护分割差。
pitfalls: 可不做修改，所以原方案数也参与最大值

solutions.title: 分割差左右频次
solutions.idea: 移动分割点集合并 O(1) 评估每个修改位置。
steps: 计算所有 pivot 的 diff=2prefix-total，初始全放 right；answer=right[0]
扫描 index；index>0 时把 pivot=index 的 diff 从 right 移到 left

code.java: class Solution { private int get(Map<Long,Integer> map,long key){return map.getOrDefault(key,0);}public int waysToPartition(int[] nums,int k){long total=0;for(int value:nums)total+=value;long[] difference=new long[nums.length];Map<Long,Integer> left=new HashMap<>(),right=new HashMap<>();long prefix=0;for(int pivot=1;pivot<nums.length;pivot++){prefix+=nums[pivot-1];difference[pivot]=2*prefix-total;right.merge(difference[pivot],1,Integer::sum);}int answer=get(right,0);for(int index=0;index<nums.length;index++){if(index>0){long value=difference[index];right.put(value,right.get(value)-1);left.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);}long delta=(long)k-nums[index];answer=Math.max(answer,get(left,delta)+get(right,-delta));}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun get(map:Map<Long,Int>,key:Long)=map[key]?:0;fun waysToPartition(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val total=nums.sumOf{it.toLong()};val difference=LongArray(nums.size);val left=HashMap<Long,Int>();val right=HashMap<Long,Int>();var prefix=0L;for(pivot in 1 until nums.size){prefix+=nums[pivot-1];difference[pivot]=2*prefix-total;right[difference[pivot]]=(right[difference[pivot]]?:0)+1};var answer=get(right,0);for(index in nums.indices){if(index>0){val value=difference[index];right[value]=right[value]!!-1;left[value]=(left[value]?:0)+1};val delta=k.toLong()-nums[index];answer=maxOf(answer,get(left,delta)+get(right,-delta))};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int get(unordered_map<long long,int>& map,long long key){return map[key];}public: int waysToPartition(vector<int>& nums,int k){long long total=accumulate(nums.begin(),nums.end(),0LL),prefix=0;vector<long long> difference(nums.size());unordered_map<long long,int> left,right;for(int pivot=1;pivot<(int)nums.size();++pivot){prefix+=nums[pivot-1];difference[pivot]=2*prefix-total;++right[difference[pivot]];}int answer=right[0];for(int index=0;index<(int)nums.size();++index){if(index){long long value=difference[index];--right[value];++left[value];}long long delta=(long long)k-nums[index];answer=max(answer,left[delta]+right[-delta]);}return answer;} };
